scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html icons.js app.js scraper.js mobile.js filter.js manga.js cinema.js style.css www/ && echo "window.BUILD = '$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')';" > www/build.js
scripts.apk: cd android && rm -rf app/src/main/assets/public && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../MEDFLIX.apk
scripts.release: npm run apk && tag=b$(cat android/app/build/build-stamp.txt) && gh release create $tag MEDFLIX.apk --title $tag --generate-notes
